.nodeTypes. GeoTiles

The GeoTiles node loads OGC 3d Tilesets from a url.

HTML Encoding and Default Values⤴

<GeoTiles bboxCenter='0,0,0' bboxColor='1, 1, 0' bboxDisplay='false' bboxMargin='0.01' bboxSize='-1,-1,-1' geoOrigin='x3dom.nodeTypes.X3DChildNode' geoSystem='['GD','WE']' maximumScreenSpaceError='8' maximumScreenSpaceError='8' metadata='X3DMetadataObject' render='true' rootUrl='[]' visible='true' ></GeoTiles>

Name Type Default Value Range Inheritance Standard Description
bboxCenter SFVec3f 0,0,0 [-inf, inf] X3DBoundedObject Center of the bounding box

metadata SFNode X3DMetadataObject X3DNode Field to add metadata information
render SFBool true X3DBoundedObject Flag to enable/disable rendering
rootUrl MFString [] The rootUrl specifies the json or x3d file for the tileset.
